data.one_liner: Detects device time, date, and timezone changes on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that listens for system time, date, and timezone changes. It exposes streams that notify listeners when these events occur.
use_when: When an app needs to adjust timers or schedules based on system time changes
When displaying relative time that must stay accurate after a user changes the clock
When reacting to day changes for daily tasks or reminders
avoid_when: When the app runs only on web or desktop platforms
When the app does not need to respond to system time changes
strengths: Supports Android and iOS out of the box
Allows listening to individual updates or all changes
Adds day change support in latest release
weaknesses: No support for web or desktop
Does not trigger when the app is completely closed
Documentation is minimal and lacks usage examples
data.setup_notes: Add the receiver block to AndroidManifest.xml and set Swift version to 5 and iOS target to 10.0 in Podfile
